name: qip-edge
purpose: A regional edge cell: the hot execution path (book, strategies, order state, capital ledger) assembled into one `Cell` type that decides without asking the centre, per ADR 0008. `Cell::on_bytes`/`Cell::work` touch memory and arithmetic only; `Cell::flush` is the one call that may block, draining a hash-chained journal to a `Mirror`.
key_contracts: cell::Cell (the aggregate: book, strategies, capital, journal, metrics)
cell::Cell::work / on_bytes / flush / deploy / withdraw / apply_policy / apply_halt
cell::Placer trait (the only order-sending seam; is_simulated() stamps every order)
cell::{GATE_LIVE_VENUE, GATE_QUOTE_BUDGET, GATE_DISPOSITION, ... } (13 named refusal gates)
mesh::{CellUplink, PolicyDownlink, CapitalDownlink} (state up / capital+policy down)
journal::{Journal, Mirror, FileMirror, MemoryMirror} (hash-chained decision record)
reservation::RegionTable / RegionAllocation (the region capital ledger, ADR-tracked gap B12 now closed)
production_evidence: backend/crates/apps/qip-edge-node/src/{pass.rs,feed.rs,mesh.rs,halt.rs,main.rs,strategies.rs,reprice.rs,gateway.rs,arbitrage.rs,dark.rs,share.rs,cross_region.rs,lib.rs} call nearly every public `Cell` method in non-test code, and backend/crates/apps/qip-cli/src/demo/mod.rs:101-104 constructs a `Cell` in the `qip demo --live` subcommand of the `qip-cli` deployable binary. But `qip-edge-node` is never deployed: `execution_nodes = {}` in every environment (infrastructure/environments/{dev,test,stage,prod}/terraform.tfvars), and the demo subcommand explicitly trades against loopback doubles it bound itself, not a venue. `qip-api`'s Cargo.toml lists `qip-edge` only under `[dev-dependencies]` (crates/apps/qip-api/Cargo.toml:50) and every `qip_edge::` mention in its src/ is inside a doc comment (crates/apps/qip-api/src/mesh.rs:724,981,1007) -- zero functional use.
io_and_state: The hot path (on_bytes/work) is memory-only by design (src/lib.rs:16-19). Two deliberate I/O seams: journal::FileMirror::ship appends JSON lines to a file via std::fs::OpenOptions (src/journal.rs:627-643), called only from Cell::flush; and mesh::CellUplink/PolicyDownlink/CapitalDownlink hold a live qip_transport::MeshPublisher (src/mesh.rs:424,451) that performs socket I/O for state-up/capital-down traffic. No book/feature/watermark state is persisted across restarts by design (books rebuild from the feed; see qip-edge-node/src/main.rs doc comment).
status_reason: Extensively tested (315 #[test] functions) and reached from a deployable binary's non-test code, but that binary is deployed nowhere (execution_nodes = {} everywhere) so no live process runs this crate's hot path today; a 9,040-line single-file Cell (src/cell.rs) is the crate's dominant, unsegmented module.
gaps_observed: qip-execution-engine is a declared dependency (Cargo.toml:39) that zero source files in this crate actually import (grep for `qip_execution_engine::` in src/*.rs returns nothing) -- kept only, per its own comment (Cargo.toml:32-38), to satisfy an architecture test's vacuity guard ('the cell reaches qip-execution-engine'), not because the cell uses it.

backend/crates/apps/qip-edge-node's binary that consumes this crate's Cell::work hot path is never instantiated by Terraform: execution_nodes = {} in infrastructure/environments/{dev,test,stage,prod}/terraform.tfvars.

src/cell.rs is 9,040 lines -- 45% of the crate's src -- and holds essentially the whole cycle (pricing, netting, crossing, disposition, halts, mesh state-delta, journal writes) as one type; no sub-module boundary inside the file.

name: qip-edge::cell

Every other module in the crate is either a policy `Cell` consults or a fact it verifies before applying.
key_contracts: Cell::new / with_venue / with_feasibility / with_settlement / with_region_allocation / with_arbitrage
Cell::deploy / deploy_with_pricing / withdraw (strategy lifecycle against capital)
Cell::on_bytes (feed ingestion, memory-only) / Cell::work (the per-pass cycle, returns WorkReport)
Cell::state_delta (produces CellStateDelta for the mesh uplink)
Cell::flush (the one blocking call, drains the journal to a Mirror)
